svg.aria-label: The shape of the climb: 10 panels, one per environment, each plotting every depth-arm model's running best champion score against the attempt that produced it, in the environment's own units. A dot marks each attempt where the running best stepped up, and a run whose surfaced pack holds fewer attempts than it registered is drawn faint and dotted rather than as a trajectory. Attempts past 12 are not drawn. Each panel's environment name sits centred under it. No legend is drawn; the lines are in registry colours for Claude Fable 5, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 4.8, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GLM-5.3, GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-6 Astra, Kimi K3, Qwen3.8-Max. Complete climbs per environment: Breakout (Atari ALE with ARI) 12 of 12; Ms. Pac-Man (Atari ALE with ARI) 12 of 12; Key Corridor (MiniGrid) 12 of 12; HalfCheetah (MuJoCo) 12 of 12; Hopper (MuJoCo) 12 of 12; Connect Four (Adapted) 12 of 12; Slime Volleyball (Adapted) 12 of 12; Tic-Tac-Toe (Adapted) 12 of 12; Pursuit (Predator) (MAgent2) 12 of 12; Overcooked (Adapted) 12 of 12.
